purpose: Design of the agent-review backend: a read-only custom Agent reviewer, an availability check SKILL, agent definition constraints, stateless operation, and test design.
summary: Overview: agent-review is a review backend SKILL whose only duty is the availability check; the review body launches reviewer directly
Architecture with component responsibilities for the agent-review SKILL, the reviewer Agent, and the review body
Agent definition constraints: no Write/Edit/Agent/Skill tools, Read/Grep/Glob/Bash allowed, plan permission mode, advisor tool forbidden
Allowed read-only git queries and forbidden mutating git operations
Rationale for permitting general command execution and why constraints do not guarantee read-only
Availability check: five conditions on the definition file, tools, model and permission mode, role rules, and required scripts and documents
Result format: available flag, missing list with axis, detail and remedy, no side effects
retains_context is always false because each round launches a fresh reviewer; it must match the resolver declaration
State and resources: no sessions, transcripts, history, DB records, or resident processes
Test design for availability check, declaration, read-only constraints, and non-persistence
tasks: Implementing or modifying the agent-review backend SKILL
Editing the reviewer custom Agent definition and its tool constraints
Implementing the availability check logic and its missing-item reporting
Reviewing design consistency between review backends and the review body
Writing tests for the availability check and read-only restrictions
Changing the retains_context declaration or backend resolution
title: DES-072 agent-review バックエンド設計
